capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists the Pure RWD (MY24-25) at 84.0 kWh usable and 88.0 nominal (search excerpt; page rate-limited), matching the 88 kWh capacity on the 2024 Lucid sheet;

chemistry.notes: Estimated: same 2170 NMC cell family; Lucid battery data lists the MY26+ packs as "Li MM(NRMC)"; no pre-2026 page names the chemistry.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Evercars says every Air runs a 900V (up to 924 V) architecture; Lucid 2025 Pure sheet says 650V+ (above 600 V, the 800 V class).

preconditioning.notes: Lucid: manual Start Preconditioning plus Smart Preconditioning (automatic when routing to a fast charger). Current software state; the page is not year-specific.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Lucid 2024 Pure sheet (US): battery capacity 88 kWh (16 module); the metric sheet says 86.

dc_max_kw.notes: Evercars (2026 comparison) and the Wikipedia trim table: Pure peak 250 kW; no Lucid Pure sheet states DC kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Lucid Canada charging page: AC charging maximum 19.2 kW; Wikipedia lists 19.2 kW (240 V, 80 A) for every trim.
